projects.title: Deathrow Original Xbox Recompilation (Exonerated)
projects.status: Pre-alpha; builds from source only, with no release executable. The README reports menu navigation and full matches working, but software-rendered gameplay is about 8–9 FPS; audio, in-game video, lighting, and some textures remain incomplete.
projects.summary: The Original Xbox x86 code is lifted into C and built as a native Windows program using xboxrecomp. A user must provide the original Xbox game files; no game code/data/assets are bundled.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; requires the user’s own Original Xbox game files; no game assets or release executable included
projects.subtype: Original Xbox game recompilation; Windows pre-alpha

projects.title: Full Spectrum Warrior: Ten Hammers Original Xbox Recompilation
projects.game: Full Spectrum Warrior: Ten Hammers (Original Xbox review build)
projects.status: The Linux bring-up reaches the real shell, profile, main-menu, difficulty-selection, and first-mission code paths. It is not playable yet: the native world frame is mostly black while Xbox vertex-shader/NV2A rendering and audio remain incomplete. The current target is a symbol-rich 5 Dec 2005 review build, not the retail XBE.
projects.summary: The Original Xbox x86 executable is statically recompiled to C and runs in a Linux Vulkan host runtime. The project uses symbols from its review build for a source-like layout and says a retail build may be evaluated later; game files are not included.
projects.strategy: Static Original Xbox x86-to-C recompilation with a Linux Vulkan runtime
projects.source_available: Public source repository; user supplies the project’s review-build game files; no game data included
projects.subtype: Original Xbox static recompilation; Linux bring-up

projects.title: FlatOut Original Xbox Recompilation Research
projects.platform: Original Xbox → host target not yet specified
projects.status: Early XBE and asset-pipeline work only. The README says current milestones are diagnostic executables and a D3D8-to-Vulkan probe; the retail game code has not yet been statically recompiled.
projects.summary: A title-specific research project built on MANXFramework, with XBE/kernel initialization, BFS asset inspection, and graphics diagnostics. It requires user-supplied game files; no playable native port is claimed.
projects.strategy: Early static-recompilation and asset-pipeline research; game code recompilation not yet started
projects.source_available: Public source and analysis tools; user supplies extracted XBE and BFS content; no game files included
projects.subtype: Original Xbox recompilation research; host target not stated

projects.title: L.A. Rush Original Xbox Recompilation Research
projects.platform: Original Xbox → host target not yet specified
projects.status: Early analysis, not a playable port. The README reports XBE layout parsing, Midway k9 engine identification, and asset-container inventory; the compiled probe uses MANXFramework’s Xbox D3D8-to-Vulkan backend.
projects.summary: Title-specific XBE and asset analysis for an intended static recompilation of L.A. Rush. The project requires user-supplied game files and does not claim game-wide recompilation or playability.
projects.strategy: Early XBE analysis and static-recompilation research using MANXFramework
projects.source_available: Public source and analysis tools; requires a user-supplied extracted Original Xbox XBE and assets
projects.subtype: Original Xbox recompilation research; host target not stated

projects.title: Halo: Combat Evolved Original Xbox Incremental Reimplementation
projects.platform: Original Xbox XBE → Original Xbox / xemu
projects.status: Status is unclear and the evidence conflicts: the README says the main loop and several functions are reimplemented but calls the project a long way from finished; its linked progress report currently shows 0.00% and no functions, and GitHub reports no push since 2023-10-09.
projects.summary: C functions are incrementally reimplemented, compiled, and patched into the original XBE so selected functions replace the original implementations. The build requires a specific user-owned retail executable and game files; this is source reimplementation, not matching decompilation.
projects.strategy: Incremental C reimplementation patched into the original Xbox executable
projects.source_available: Public C/Python source; user supplies retail game files and executable version 01.10.12.2276; no game assets included
